name: Frog
otherStatistics: Perception +1 and Stealth +3. Darkvision 30 ft. Passive Perception 11. No listed languages.
appearance: A compact frog with a blunt head, amber eyes, olive-brown skin and powerful folded hind legs.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), D&D Basic Rules v1.0, November 2018, and printed p. 128.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathe in air or water.
Standing Leap. Jump up to 10 ft. horizontally or 5 ft. vertically from a standstill or after a run-up.
sections.Actions: The printed Frog has no effective attacks.

name: Wolf
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +3 and Stealth +4. Passive Perception 13. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A gray-brown canine with a deep chest, pointed ears, long legs and a low bushy tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual (2014), First printing, September 2014, printed p. 341. https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/mm-2014
sections.Traits:
Keen Hearing and Smell. The wolf has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use hearing or smell.
Pack Tactics. Gain advantage on an attack against a creature if at least one ally of the wolf is within 5 ft. of the target and that ally is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage. A creature hit this way must pass a DC 11 Strength save or fall prone.
